tables.label: Table 1
tables.caption: Peptide Designations and Properties
footnotes: Amino acids shown in bold are d-enantiomers. All of the peptides are amidated on their C-termini.

The peptides were eluted in a C18 reverse-phase analytical column. The duration of the elution was 40 min, using a linear gradient from 10% to 90% acetonitrile (AcN) in water, both containing 0.1% (v/v) TFA. The percentage of AcN was calculated according to the elution time.
Hydrophobic moment (μH) of AMPs using HeliQuest (http://heliquest.ipmc.cnrs.fr).

tables.label: Table 2
tables.caption: MIC90 Values (micromolar) of CF Patient Isolates of P. aeruginosaa
footnotes: The MIC (micromolar) was measured by a serial dilution method performed in a 96-well polystyrene plate. Plates were incubated for 24 h at 37 °C followed by absorbance (600 nm) measurements for bacterial growth.
